agent_assumptions: North=plan top, South=plan bottom, West=plan left, East=plan right (unchanged from seed).

REVISION: mid-level west dimension chain (4060/2940/4940/8060mm, sum=20000) and pixel-profile wall detection (full-width gray wall lines at original pixel y=296,403,583, matching predicted offsets from a calibrated 150->876px=0..20000mm axis) show the true west-side partition walls are at world y=15.94, 13.0, 8.06 (measuring from north=20). This does NOT match the seed's furniture-based guesses (17.734/13.74/11.04/6.28).

REVISION: Between the west partitions at y=13.0 and y=8.06 (a 4.94m-tall room), the drawing shows two mirrored wardrobe+desk furniture groups but NO dividing wall (pixel scan found a single full-width wall only at y=403 and y=583 px, none at the visually-expected midpoint ~499px). Per scope guidance, this is ONE room with two symmetric furniture groups, not two separate offices. Seed's Office2 and Office3 are merged into one cell 'Office2'.

REVISION: the same y=296px (world y=15.94) wall is a full-width wall (visible spanning both the west column and the east/sofa-room column in the plan), so it is also the correct Reception/TopRightRoom boundary, replacing the seed's mistaken 17.734 value on both sides.
MeetingDining south partition unaffected (still the building's south exterior wall at y=0); its north boundary moves from the seed's furniture-based 6.28 to the measured 8.06.

Doors D_Rec_Corridor and D_Corridor_TopRightRoom, whose hosting wall moved from y=17.734 to y=15.94, are shifted by the same delta so they still sit on their host wall; exact pixel arc position not independently re-measured (approximate, evidenced by wall relocation only).
Door D_Corridor_Office1 (on the vertical corridor wall) is shifted down proportionally to remain inside the resized Office1 cell; not pixel-verified beyond staying inside the new bounds.

Doors D_Corridor_Office2 and D_Corridor_Office3 (renamed target 'Office2') keep their original pixel-based coordinates unchanged; both already fall inside the merged room's new bounds, so both apertures (two distinct visible arcs) are preserved rather than dropped.
West-facade window spans (already pixel-matched to the fine inner dimension chain in a prior pass) are unchanged; only their 'room' host field is corrected to the merged/resized cells.
Exact interior door swing directions and leaf widths not verified pixel-by-pixel.
Wall thickness taken as nominal 240mm per plan label; representative centerline geometry used (offsets_m unknown).
Corridor spine x-extent (3.767 to 5.843) unchanged from seed; not independently re-derived from the south mid-chain (4180/1640/4180) in this pass -- left as an unresolved possible discrepancy.
East-side room partitions (MeetingRoomBig/BottomRightOffice boundary at y=7.3, from the prior East-elevation-based revision) retained unchanged; not re-examined in this pass.
Single floor building (only 1F plan supplied); elevations show only ground floor height (4.5m).
unresolved: East-side (right column) partitions not independently re-derived from a matching dimension chain in this pass; TopRightRoom's lower bound (14.38) and MeetingRoomBig/BottomRightOffice split (7.3) carried over from the prior seed revision, not re-verified against a pixel-profile scan like the west column.

Corridor x-extent (3.767 to 5.843) not re-derived from the south mid-chain (4180/1640/4180mm); left unchanged from seed. If that chain in fact marks the corridor's real wall faces at x=4.18/5.82, the corridor and adjoining MeetingDining/BottomRightOffice x-boundaries may need a further ~0.4m correction.
Doors whose host wall moved (D_Rec_Corridor, D_Corridor_TopRightRoom, D_Corridor_Office1) were shifted by calculation/proportion to remain valid, not re-measured from door-arc pixels directly.
Wall thicknesses/offsets not surveyed via check_wall_dimensions (representative centerline geometry only).
